evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies JSON-RPC batch parsing machinery in src/rpc/request.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an RPC batching bug where invalid batch elements inherit the preceding element's ID or have their error dropped after notifications. As noted in the discussion, this resolves a JSON-RPC 2.0 spec discrepancy that 'could confuse consumers of the interface expecting unique IDs in batch responses', but it specifically affects error handling for malformed batch payloads.
